description:
List your warning mail settings

Which warning mails your account gets and how often, as in the notification settings of the dashboard. One entry per warning that can reach you: `balance` (balance runs low; for a partner, `partner` true, the partner balance), `trial` (starting credit runs out), `numbers` (phone number documents or renewal), `integrations` (a connected service stopped working), for partners `customer_orders` (a customer could not buy a number, plan or credit). `interval` is `event`, `daily`, `weekly` or `off`; every warning is `off` until switched on. Tickets, sign in codes and security mails always arrive and are not listed. Change one with `set_warning_mail`. Owner only, a team member gets 403.
name: get_warning_mail_settings
title: List your warning mail settings
